description: Convert an ingredient amount between US and metric units, or to one unit (g, ml, cup, oz, tbsp...). Volume to weight only for items with a known density (e.g. 250 g sugar to cups). Send one "line", up to 100 "lines", or "amount" + "unit" (+ "item" for volume <-> weight), and "to". More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

item.description: The ingredient (needed for volume <-> weight), e.g. sugar.

line.description: One ingredient line, e.g. "1 1/2 cups flour".

prefer.description: Keep the kind of unit (same, default), or prefer weight or volume.

rounding.description: Round to kitchen-friendly amounts (default) or not at all.

spoons.description: Keep teaspoons and tablespoons as they are (default) or convert them too.

to.description: "metric", "us" or a unit: tsp, tbsp, cup, fl oz, pint, quart, gallon, ml, l, oz, lb, g, kg.

unit.description: The amount's unit, e.g. g, cup, oz.

name: convert_ingredient
title: Convert ingredient units
